$comment: Write-guard and Preview classification for MongoDB, shared by every binding. Command names are the first key of the command document, compared case-insensitively. Anything not listed is a write. See spec/data-stores.md.
source: MongoDB 8.2 database commands; transaction limits checked against mongo:8.2 in tests/conformance/compose.yml

conditional.aggregate: A write when any stage, at any depth of the pipeline, is $out or $merge.
conditional.explain: Classified as the command inside its explain field.
conditional.findAndModify: Always a write, including findOneAndUpdate, findOneAndReplace and findOneAndDelete with no match.
conditional.abortTransaction: Allowed for a transaction the handler started itself. In Preview the binding owns the transaction and refuses a handler's abortTransaction or commitTransaction for it.

notInTransaction.$comment: Refused by the server inside a multi-document transaction. In Preview mode a binding blocks these before sending, with the reason below.
rules: createIndexes on a collection that existed before the transaction
any write to a capped collection
any operation on the admin, config or local database, or on a system.* collection
notInTransaction.reason: Preview unavailable: MongoDB can't run {operation} inside a transaction
